Hebrews 10:3 employs the same word in a contrasting direction, noting that the annual sacrifices serve as a reminder of sins rather than their removal. Spanish 'memoria/recuerdo' and German 'Erinnerung' both capture the commemorative force, while French 'souvenir' leans toward personal memory."

Multilingual glosses uniformly render this as commemorative memory (spa 'memoria,' deu 'Erinnerung')...
